result.summary: Found 1 major visual defect: a broken, failed-to-load image placeholder in a restaurant listing card, which breaks the intended visual presentation of the page.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a grey box with a crossed-out image icon (broken image placeholder) instead of the intended restaurant/food imagery.
issues.suggestion: Load the correct image asset for the Tokumaru Ramen Bar listing, or add a relevant, themed fallback image to use if the primary image cannot be retrieved.
